physical_algebra.conjugate_delay_identity: conj(s[n])=-j*s[n-10]; only nuisance models admitting this delay/free-tone response absorb it
physical_algebra.effective_information_scope: identity-whitened complex Gram diagnostic; not estimated physical noise Fisher

linear_action_bound.proof: triangle/reverse-triangle with each finite causal shift operator norm<=1

physical_contract.timing_diagnostic: best public-template correlation on320 delays at1/16 sample, each window only reported, not corrected
physical_contract.temporal_projective: per-tone [early,reference] complex projectors; 3 independent real coordinates
physical_contract.temporal_gain_invariance: shared nonzero complex gain per tone, above declared energy floor
physical_contract.nonlinear_generation: continuous Fourier convolution -> strict |f|<10MHz -> final 25Msps samples
physical_contract.nuisance: 12 free complex linear tones, DC, phase, delay derivative, complex-span local CFO tangent
physical_contract.whitening: identity Sigma assumption; unknown noise covariance is not estimated
physical_contract.nonlinear_timing_gauge: fixed public template origin; no claim of recovered PA coefficients
physical_contract.nonlinear_80_window: periodic finite-window ideal mask, then fixed 80-sample nuisance projection and residual SVD
physical_contract.nonlinear_repeat: same fixed 20-sample projection separately on four cycles; off-diagonal energy not clamped
physical_contract.repeat_energy_unbiased_condition: only independent zero-mean innovations after fixed preprocessing; shared estimated CFO can violate this
physical_contract.cfo: one reference[80,160) lag20 wrapped estimate corrects all256 samples; no per-window CFO estimation
limitations: Static equal steady windows produce a constant temporal projector and no new TX evidence.
RX AGC, synchronization, link response and preprocessing may also produce dynamic residuals.
Complex nonlinear coordinates retain a received phase/timing gauge; they are not arbitrary-channel invariants.
Strict ideal 20MHz passband is an explicit analysis assumption, not measured receiver filtering.
